description: Have CosVoice start YOU the moment something arrives, instead of you polling. Give it the webhook URL and key of a routine of yours that has a Webhook trigger (Grok Bot: Routines → New → trigger Webhook; the URL and a crsr_ key appear). CosVoice POSTs a JSON body with what_to_do plus the ids when the owner texts an instruction, an email arrives, or a call finishes; that body becomes the routine's input. Pass an empty url to turn it off. events limits which moments wake you (default all three).

key.description: Bearer key for that URL (for Grok, the crsr_… key shown with the webhook).

name: set_bot_push
title: Set Bot push (wake me up)
